svg.title: Multi-Region Active-Active
svg.desc: Multi-Region Active-Active. Serve users from several regions at once and shift traffic away from a region that fails. Step 1, Both regions serve: Each user group is routed to its nearest region. Both regions serve traffic and pass health checks. Step 2, Replicate data: Writes commit locally, then replicate asynchronously to the other region. Reads stay local. Step 3, Region B fails: Region B goes down. Its health checks fail, so the global load balancer marks it unhealthy. Step 4, Fail over: Americas traffic is routed to Region A: a longer trip, but still served. Region A scales out.

g.text: Each user group is routed to its nearest region. Both regions serve traffic and pass health checks.
